generator_cmd: printf %s "$plain" | perl -ne "print join q( ), map { sprintf q(%07b), ord } split //"  # perl: 7-bit ASCII binary of the sentence
oracle_cmd: (cwd: `pip download --no-deps luma.led_matrix==1.9.0` unzipped to x/; its segment_mapper _DIGITS abcdefg+dp table) python3 -I -c 'import ast,re,sys; src=open("x/luma/led_matrix/segment_mapper.py").read(); d=ast.literal_eval(re.search(r"_DIGITS = (\{.*?\n\})", src, re.S).group(1)); inv={d[c] for c in "0123456789abcdef"}; print([t for t in sys.argv[1].split() if int(t, 2) not in inv and int(t, 2) & 0x7f not in inv][:5])' "$encoded"  # -> tokens that are no luma hex glyph: 7-bit ASCII binary is not seven-segment
